task.problem_statement: Select the newest staged ScriptOps candidate by numeric version so v10 is not treated as older than v9.
precondition_argv: import importlib.util,tempfile,sys; from pathlib import Path; spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('hardening','phase6/scriptops-v2-hardening.py'); module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module); directory=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); module.ROOT=Path(directory.name); staging=module.ROOT/'staging'/'scenes'; staging.mkdir(parents=True); (staging/'SCN-001-v9-candidate.fountain').write_text('v9'); (staging/'SCN-001-v10-candidate.fountain').write_text('v10'); sys.exit(0 if module._latest_candidate('SCN-001').name=='SCN-001-v10-candidate.fountain' else 1)
postcondition_argv: import importlib.util,tempfile,sys; from pathlib import Path; spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('hardening','phase6/scriptops-v2-hardening.py'); module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module); directory=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); module.ROOT=Path(directory.name); staging=module.ROOT/'staging'/'scenes'; staging.mkdir(parents=True); (staging/'SCN-001-v9-candidate.fountain').write_text('v9'); (staging/'SCN-001-v10-candidate.fountain').write_text('v10'); sys.exit(0 if module._latest_candidate('SCN-001').name=='SCN-001-v10-candidate.fountain' else 1)
